--- layout: default title: The arm, iteration by iteration ---

This is the recovery procedure itself, on the full upper body. The solid arm is the challenger the current objective produces, tinted by joint torque; the translucent arm is the demonstration it is being compared against; the brown cylinder is the stick it scrapes. Step through the outer iterations to watch the cost field, the sampled posture cloud and the press develop.

This page illustrates the procedure, not the reported results. It is built from an earlier recovery pipeline whose joint errors are far larger than those the paper reports, and it is kept because no later run produces this view. For the numbers, see Contact, discovered.
